Mary, mother of Jesus: Ɔbaabun Kronkron Maria, Onyankopɔn Maame ne Asɔre no Maame, nea wɔpaw no fi daa nyinaa sɛ ɔnwo Agyenkwa no. Wɔnyinsɛn no a bɔne nni ne ho na ɔyɛ ɔbaabun daa, na wɔfaa no ne nipadua ne ne kra kɔɔ soro.
Our Lady of Guadalupe: Afe 1531 mu Ɔbaabun Kronkron no yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ Ɔhotefo Juan Diego wɔ Tepeyac koko so bɛn Mexico City, na ogyaw ne mfonini wɔ ne ntama so. Ɔno ne Amerika Ɔbanbɔfo.
Our Lady of Fátima: Afe 1917 mu Ɔbaabun Kronkron no yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ mmofra nguanhwɛfo baasa wɔ Fátima wɔ Portugal, na ɔfrɛɛ wiase sɛ ɛmmɔ mpae, ɛnsakra adwene, ɛmmɔ Rosari da biara na ɛmfa ne ho mma ne Koma a Nkekae Biara Nni Ho no.
Our Lady of Lourdes: Afe 1858 mu Ɔbaabun Kronkron no yii ne ho adi mprɛnu dunwɔtwe kyerɛɛ Ɔhotefo Bernadette wɔ Lourdes wɔ France, na ɔkae sɛ: “Mene Nyinsɛn a Nkekae Biara Nni Ho no.” Efi saa bere no, ne asubura a ɛwɔ hɔ no ayɛ ayaresabea ne akwantu kronkron beae.
Our Lady of Aparecida: Afe 1717 mu, apofofo twee Nyinsɛn a Nkekae Biara Nni Ho no mfonini ketewa bi fii Paraíba asubɔnten mu, na wɔn asau a hwee nni mu no hyɛɛ nam ma. Yɛn Ɛna a ɔwɔ Aparecida ne Brazil Ɔhemmaa ne Ɔbanbɔfo.
Our Mother of Perpetual Help: Yɛn Ɛna a Ne Mmoa Nni Awiei
Tete mfonini bi a ɛkyerɛ Abofra Yesu sɛ ɔretu mmirika akɔ ne Maame nkyɛn bere a wahu ne Amanehunu nneɛma no. Nhyira Pius IX de maa Redemptorist asɔfo afe 1866 mu sɛ wɔmma wiase nyinaa nhu.
Our Lady of the Pillar: Yɛn Ɛna a ɔwɔ Dua no so
Amammerɛ ka sɛ Ɔbaabun Kronkron no baa Ɔsomafo Ɔhotefo Yakobo nkyɛn wɔ Zaragoza sɛ ɔmma n'asɛnka wɔ Spain mu nyɛ den, na ogyaw dua bi sɛ agyiraehyɛde. Ɔno ne Spain ne Hispanik aman no Ɔbanbɔfo.
Our Lady of Mount Carmel: Yɛn Ɛna a ɔwɔ Karmel Bepɔ so
Maria sɛ Karmel Asɔfokuw no Maame ne Ɔbanbɔfo. Ɔde Ntama Kɔkɔɔ-tuntum (Scapular) no maa Ɔhotefo Simon Stock sɛ ne banbɔ agyiraehyɛde ma wɔn a wɔde hyɛ no gyidi mu nyinaa.
Our Lady of the Rosary: Afahyɛ yi kae nkonim a wodii wɔ Lepanto afe 1571 mu, bere a agyidifo bɔɔ Rosari mpae. Ɛfrɛ yɛn sɛ yɛne ne Maame nsusuw Kristo ahintasɛm ho.
Our Lady of Sorrows: Yɛn Ɛna a Ɔwɔ Awerɛhow mu
Ɛhyɛ Maame Nhyira no anuonyam wɔ ne Ba no Amanehunu a ɔde ne awerɛhow ason kyɛ mu, efi Simeon nkɔmhyɛ kosi Yesu ayiyɛ. Ogyinaa Asɛndua no ase nokware mu.
Immaculate Conception: Nyinsɛn a Nkekae Biara Nni Ho
Ɛnam Onyankopɔn adom soronko bi so, wɔbɔɔ Ɔbaabun Kronkron Maria ho ban fii bɔne fitiase ho efi ne nyinsɛn simma a edi kan no. Ɛyɛ United States ɔbanbɔfo afahyɛ.
Assumption of Mary: Ɔbaabun Kronkron Maria asase so abrabɔ awiei no, wɔfaa no ne nipadua ne ne kra kɔɔ soro anuonyam mu, sɛnea Pope Pius XII de anuonyam kyerɛɛ mu afe 1950 mu.
Sacred Heart: Fiada a edi Kwasiada a ɛto so abien a edi Pentekoste akyi no akyi
Yesu Koma Kronkron Paa no ho ɔsom hyɛ ne dɔ a ɛhyew ma nnipa no anuonyam. Yɛn Awurade yii ne bɔhyɛ adi kyerɛɛ Ɔhotefo Margaret Mary Alacoque wɔ mfe 1670 mu.
Holy Family: Yesu, Maria ne Yosef wɔ wɔn fie wɔ Nasaret, Kristofo abusua biara nhwɛso wɔ gyidi, ɔdɔ ne Onyankopɔn tie mu.
Trinity: Yɛn gyidi ahintasɛm titiriw: Onyankopɔn baako wɔ Onyankopɔn Nipa baasa mu, Agya no, Ba no ne Honhom Kronkron no.
Holy Spirit in Christianity: Baasakoro Kronkron Paa no mu Nipa a ɔto so abiɛsa, Awurade ne Nkwa Mafo, nea ɔbaa Asomafo no so wɔ Pentekoste da no na ɔtew Asɔre no ho.
Christ the King: Asɔre afe no Kwasiada a etwa to
Pope Pius XI hyɛɛ afahyɛ kɛse yi ase afe 1925 mu sɛ ɔde bɛpae mu aka Yesu Kristo ahenni wɔ koma biara, abusua biara ne ɔman biara so.
Divine Mercy: Pasua Kwasiada a ɛto so abien

Onyankopɔn mmɔborohunu dɔ ho ɔsom a oyii no adi kyerɛɛ Ɔhotefo Faustina Kowalska, a ne nyinaa wɔ mpaebɔ yi mu: “Yesu, mede me ho to wo so.” Ɔhotefo Yohane Paulo II hyɛɛ Onyankopɔn Mmɔborohunu Kwasiada ase afe 2000 mu.
Santo Niño de Cebú: Ɔpɛpɔn Kwasiada a ɛto so abiɛsa
Abofra Kronkron Yesu mfonini a wɔde maa Cebu ɔhemmaa bere a wɔbɔɔ no asu afe 1521 mu, Kristofo mfonini a ɛyɛ dedaw sen biara wɔ Philippines.
Juan Diego: Ɔhotefo Juan Diego Cuauhtlatoatzin, kurom ni ahobrɛasefo a ɔsesaa ne ho a Yɛn Ɛna a ɔwɔ Guadalupe yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ no afe 1531 mu. Ɔhotefo Yohane Paulo II bɔɔ no din sɛ ɔhotefo afe 2002 mu.
Kateri Tekakwitha: “Mohawk Sukooko Nhwiren” (1656–1680), ababaa bi a ɔsesaa ne ho, na ne ho tew na ɔbɔ mpae pii, North America kurom ni a odi kan a ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔhotefo.
Martin de Porres: Dominikan onua a ofi Lima wɔ Peru (1579–1639), nea wonim no ahobrɛase a ɔde hwɛɛ ayarefo ne ahiafo a wofi mmusua ahorow nyinaa mu. Atɛntrenee Ɔbanbɔfo.
Francis Xavier: Yesu Asɔfokuw (Jesuit) a wodi kan no mu baako, ɔde Asɛmpa no kɔɔ India, Asia Apuei-Anafo ne Japan, na ɔbɔɔ nnipa mpempem pii asu. Asɛmpaka Ɔbanbɔfo.
Francis de Sales: Geneva Bishɔp ne Asɔre Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo (1567–1622), nea ɔkyerɛkyerɛe sɛ wɔafrɛ obiara sɛ ɔnyɛ kronkron. Akyerɛwfo ne amanneɛbɔfo Ɔbanbɔfo.
Saint Joseph: Ɔbaabun Kronkron Maria kunu ne Yesu agya a ɔtetee no, ɔtreneeni a ɔbɔɔ Abusua Kronkron no ho ban. Asɔre a ɛwɔ wiase nyinaa, agyanom ne adwumayɛfo ne owu pa Ɔbanbɔfo.
Saint Patrick: Ireland Bishɔp ne Ɔsomafo wɔ afeha a ɛto so anum mu. Wɔfaa no akoa kɔɔ Ireland bere a ɔyɛ abofra, na ɔsan baa hɔ sɛ ɔsɛmpakafo na ɔde supɔw no baa gyidi mu.
Anthony of Padua: Fransiskan ɔsɔfo ne Asɔre Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo (1195–1231), ɔsɛnkafo a ne nsɛm yɛ den na ɔyɛɛ anwonwade. Ahiafo ne nneɛma a ayera Ɔbanbɔfo.
Francis of Assisi: Fransiskanfo no Hyɛasefo (1181–1226), nea ɔde ne ho maa ohia sɛ ɔde bedi Kristo akyi na onyaa stigmata, Awurade apirakuro no. Italy ne mmoa Ɔbanbɔfo.
John the Baptist: Awurade Kan-Ɔsomafo, nea ɔkaa adwensakra ho asɛm, ɔbɔɔ Yesu asu wɔ Yordan na ɔde ne nkwa too hɔ sɛ adansefo wui maa nokware.
Michael (archangel): Soro asafo Ɔheneba, nea ɔbɔ Onyankopɔn nkurɔfo ho ban fi ɔbonsam nnaadaa ho. Asraafo, polisifo ne ayarefo Ɔbanbɔfo.
Raphael (archangel): Ɔbɔfopanyin a ɔkyerɛɛ Tobia kwan na ɔsaa Tobit yare; ne din kyerɛ sɛ “Onyankopɔn sa yare.” Akwantufo ne ayaresa Ɔbanbɔfo.
Gabriel: Ɔbɔfopanyin a ɔbɔɔ Ɔbaabun Maria amanneɛ sɛ ɔbɛyɛ Onyankopɔn Ba no Maame. Asomafo Ɔbanbɔfo.
Saint Peter: Asomafo no Ɔheneba ne Pope a odi kan, nea Kristo de Ahenni no nsafe maa no. Wokum no sɛ adansefo wɔ Roma na ɔda Ɔhotefo Petro Basilika ase.
Paul the Apostle: Amanaman Ɔsomafo, nea ɔsesaa ne ho wɔ Damasko kwan so. N'akwantu ne ne nkrataa de Asɛmpa no trɛw Roma wiase nyinaa, na wokum no sɛ adansefo wɔ Roma.
Saint Anne: Ɔbaabun Kronkron Maria maame ne Yesu nananom, a wɔne Ɔhotefo Yoakim hyɛ no anuonyam. Ɛnanom ne nananom Ɔbanbɔfo.
Thérèse of Lisieux: Karmel osistafo ne Asɔre Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo (1873–1897), Nhwiren Ketewa no, nea ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ ahotoso ne ɔdɔ “kwan ketewa” no. Asɛmpaka Ɔbanbɔfo.
Jude the Apostle: Ɔsomafo ne Awurade busuani, Yuda Krataa no kyerɛwfo. Nsɛm a anidaso nni mu Ɔbanbɔfo.
Vincent de Paul: France ɔsɔfo (1581–1660) a ɔhyɛɛ Asɛmpaka Asɔfokuw ne Ɔdɔ Mmabea ase. Ɔdɔ nnwuma nyinaa Ɔbanbɔfo.
Thomas Aquinas: Dominikan ɔsɔfo ne Asɔre Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo (1225–1274), Summa Theologiae kyerɛwfo. Katolek sukuu ne asuafo Ɔbanbɔfo.
Rita of Cascia: Ɔyere, ɛna, okunafo ne Augustinian osistafo (1381–1457) a ɔde abotare kɛse hunuu amane. Nsɛm a entumi nyɛ yiye Ɔbanbɔfo.
Augustine of Hippo: Bishɔp ne Asɔre Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo (354–430), nea ɔsesaa ne ho esiane ne maame Ɔhotefo Monika mpaebɔ nti. Confessions kyerɛwfo.
Saint Monica: Ɔhotefo Augustine maame, nea ne mfe pii nokware mpaebɔ ma ne ba no sesaa ne ho. Ɛnanom ne yerenom Ɔbanbɔfo.
Saint Sebastian: Roma sraani a wokum no sɛ adansefo maa gyidi no wɔ Diocletian bere so bɛyɛ afe 288. Asraafo ne agumadifo Ɔbanbɔfo.
Saint Lawrence: Roma diakɔn a wokum no sɛ adansefo afe 258 mu, nea ɔde ahiafo kyerɛe sɛ wɔne Asɔre no ademude ankasa. Diakɔnfo ne ahiafo Ɔbanbɔfo.
Saint Stephen: Diakɔnfo ason a wodi kan no mu baako ne Asɔre no adansefo a odi kan, nea owui bere a ɔrebɔ mpae ama wɔn a wɔde abo sii no no.
Saint Nicholas: Myra Bishɔp wɔ afeha a ɛto so anan mu, nea nnipa dɔ no esiane n'adɔe ne akyɛde a ɔde maa wɔ kokoam nti. Mmofra ne po so adwumayɛfo Ɔbanbɔfo.
Saint George: Sraani ne adansefo wɔ afeha a ɛto so anan mfiase, akokoduru nhwɛso wɔ gyidi mu. Asraafo ne scout Ɔbanbɔfo.
James the Great: Ɔsomafo ne Ɔhotefo Yohane nua, Dumien no mu nea odi kan a wokum no sɛ adansefo. Ne kronkronbea a ɛwɔ Santiago de Compostela twetwe akwantufo kronkron ba Camino so. Spain Ɔbanbɔfo.
Andrew the Apostle: Ɔhotefo Petro nua ne Asomafo no mu nea wɔfrɛɛ no kan, nea ɔde Petro baa Yesu nkyɛn. Wokum no wɔ asɛndua so sɛ adansefo wɔ Patras. Scotland Ɔbanbɔfo.
Martin of Tours: Roma sraani a ɔne ɔsrɛfo bi kyɛɛ ne ntama na akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ Tours Bishɔp (owui 397). Asraafo Ɔbanbɔfo.
Benedict of Nursia: Atɔe fam ahosiesifo abrabɔ agya (bɛyɛ 480–547), nea ne mpaebɔ ne adwuma Mmara no kyerɛɛ ahosiesifo kwan mfehaha pii. Europa Ɔbanbɔfo.
Saint Dominic: Asɛnkafo Asɔfokuw no Hyɛasefo (1170–1221), nea ɔde ne ho maa nokware ho asɛnka ne Rosari.
Ignatius of Loyola: Sraani a ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔhotefo (1491–1556) a ɔhyɛɛ Yesu Asɔfokuw ase na ɔkyerɛw Honhom mu Nnwuma no, ne nyinaa “ma Onyankopɔn anuonyam kɛse.”
Charles Borromeo: Milan Akyerɛkyerɛfo Panyin (1538–1584) a ɔyɛɛ Asɔre no foforo wɔ Trent Nhyiam akyi na ɔhwɛɛ ayarefo wɔ ɔyaredɔm bere mu.
Elizabeth Ann Seton: Ɔyere, ɛna, okunafo ne obi a ɔsesaa ne ho (1774–1821) a ɔhyɛɛ Ɔdɔ Asistafo ne Katolek sukuu ase wɔ Amerika. Ɔhotefo a odi kan a wɔwoo no wɔ United States.
Isidore the Laborer: Madrid afuom dwumayɛni (owui 1130), nea ɔkɔɔ Omisa da biara nokware mu na ɔma ahiafo ade. Akuafo Ɔbanbɔfo.
Saint Lucy: Ɔbaabun ne adansefo a ofi Syracuse (owui 304), nea ne din kyerɛ “hann.” Anifuraefo Ɔbanbɔfo.
Saint Cecilia: Ɔbaabun ne adansefo a ofi Roma a ɔtoo dwom maa Onyankopɔn wɔ ne koma mu. Nnwontofo ne nnwom kronkron Ɔbanbɔfo.
Clare of Assisi: Ɔhotefo Francis akyidifo (1194–1253) ne Poor Clares Hyɛasefo, nea ɔde ne ho maa ohia ne Sakrament Kronkron no.
Pope John Paul II: Pope efi 1978 kosi 2005, wɔwoo no Karol Wojtyła wɔ Poland, akwantufo kronkron a ɔmmrɛ da a ɔfrɛɛ wiase sɛ “mommma mo ho nnyɛ mo hu.” Wɔbɔɔ ne din sɛ ɔhotefo afe 2014 mu.
Pope Pius X: Pope efi 1903 kosi 1914 a ɔhyɛɛ nkuran sɛ wonnye Ahyiadi Kronkron mpɛn pii na obuee kwan maa mmofra nketewa, “sɛ ɔde nneɛma nyinaa bɛsan aba Kristo mu.”
Luke the Evangelist: Ɔyaresafo ne Ɔhotefo Paulo yɔnko, Luka Asɛmpa ne Asomafo Nnwuma kyerɛwfo. Ayaresafo ne adwinnifo Ɔbanbɔfo.
Mark the Evangelist: Ɔhotefo Petro yɔnko ne Marko Asɛmpa kyerɛwfo. Venice Ɔbanbɔfo.
Matthew the Apostle: Towgyefo a Yesu frɛɛ no sɛ ɔnyɛ Ɔsomafo, Asɛmpa a edi kan no kyerɛwfo.
Bartholomew the Apostle: Dumien no mu baako, nea Awurade frɛɛ no “Israelni a nnaadaa nni ne mu,” nea ɔkaa Asɛmpa no na owui sɛ adansefo.
Helena, mother of Constantine I: Ɔhempɔn yere ne Constantine Kɛse maame, nea ɔkɔɔ akwantu kronkron wɔ Yerusalem na ohuu Asɛndua Nokware no.
Brigid of Kildare: Kildare ahosiesifo mmaa panyin (owui bɛyɛ 525), nea nnipa dɔ no esiane n'adɔe ne ahɔhoyɛ nti. Ireland Ɔbanbɔfo.
Louis IX of France: Ɔhotefo Louis IX a ofi France
France ɔhene (1214–1270), ɔtreneeni hene a ɔde ne ho maa mpaebɔ ne ahiafo.
